map.倒虹吸水头损失与埋深（本页代码口径，g=9.81 m/s²）：沿程损失 hf=λ: Inverted siphon head loss and burial depth (as implemented on this page, g = 9.81 m/s²): friction loss hf = λ×(L÷D)×v²÷(2g) and minor loss hj = Σζ×v²÷(2g) (m; v pipe velocity in m/s, D diameter in m, L length in m, λ friction factor, Σζ minor loss sum); total head loss = hf + hj; recommended minimum burial depth (inlet–outlet level difference) = total head loss + margin (m, burial safety margin). Validation: v, D, L and λ are required and must be greater than 0 (D is a divisor); Σζ and margin may be 0 but not negative; otherwise the tool stops with a message. Criteria: v of 1.5–3.0 m/s is favorable — below 1.5 m/s the pipe silts easily, above 3.0 m/s scouring is likely and water hammer must be checked.
